result.instructions: Tools for Areye, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much would a ride from our Gaborone office to the airport cost right now?"; "Show me all trips from last month that were cancelled, with their reasons."; "Which of our delivery batches still have stops that have not been collected?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Areye data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run areye_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run areye_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run areye_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. areye_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: areye_profile
tools.title: Get business profile
tools.description: Show the business account this key belongs to: company name, billing contact, webhook URL and portal role. Areye API: GET /business/profile.

tools.name: areye_dashboard
tools.title: Get account dashboard
tools.description: Show aggregate account metrics: trips, spend and active employees. Areye API: GET /business/dashboard.

tools.name: areye_list_billing_statements
tools.title: List billing statements
tools.description: List the monthly billing statements for the account. Areye API: GET /business/billing/statements.

tools.name: areye_list_zones
tools.title: List service zones
tools.description: List the active Areye service zones (the cities and areas where bookings are possible). Pickup must fall inside a zone. Areye API: GET /business/zones.

tools.name: areye_list_vehicle_types
tools.title: List vehicle types
tools.description: List vehicle types with live pricing and availability. Prefer declaring parcel_size or parcel_weight_kg when booking. Areye API: GET /business/vehicle-types.

tools.name: areye_list_parcel_sizes
tools.title: List parcel sizes
tools.description: List the live parcel size tiers with weight ranges, eligible vehicle types and rates. Read this before choosing parcel_size. Areye API: GET /business/parcel-sizes.

tools.name: areye_fare_estimate
tools.title: Estimate a fare
tools.description: Price a trip before booking it. Uses the same calculator as areye_book_trip. This tool does not book anything. Areye API: GET /business/trip/fare-estimate.

tools.name: areye_list_trips
tools.title: List trips
tools.description: List trips, newest first. Filter by month, reference, or a search over reference, passenger, address and your external_reference. Use test=0 to hide sandbox trips from live results. Areye API: GET /business/trips.

test.description: 0 = live trips only, 1 = test trips only.

tools.name: areye_active_trips
tools.title: List active trips
tools.description: List trips that are in progress now. Areye API: GET /business/trips/active.

tools.name: areye_get_trip
tools.title: Get a trip
tools.description: Get one trip with its receipt, route details and status. Areye API: GET /business/trips/{reference}.

reference.description: Areye reference (ARY-…), trip id, or your own external_reference.

tools.name: areye_list_batches
tools.title: List batches
tools.description: List bulk delivery batches with the status of each stop. Areye API: GET /business/batches.

tools.name: areye_get_batch
tools.title: Get a batch
tools.description: Get one bulk delivery batch with all of its stops. Areye API: GET /business/batches/{id}.

tools.name: areye_book_trip
tools.title: Book a ride or parcel delivery
tools.description: Book a ride or a parcel delivery. This charges the account wallet or credit limit and dispatches a driver. Call areye_fare_estimate first. Every booking needs your own external_reference; a retry with the same reference and body returns the first booking, not a second one. Areye API: POST /business/book.

type.description: ride = passenger trip; parcel = delivery to a recipient.

external_reference.description: Your own order id, stable and unique per order (max 80 characters). Reuse the same value on a retry.

parcel_size.description: Parcel only. Size tier from areye_list_parcel_sizes.

vehicle_type_id.description: Override the vehicle type. Prefer parcel_size or parcel_weight_kg.

expense_code.description: Your expense code for this trip.

annotations.title: Book a ride or parcel delivery

tools.name: areye_cancel_trip
tools.title: Cancel a trip
tools.description: Cancel a trip before pickup. The business pays no cancellation charge and the wallet charge is refunded. After pickup the API refuses with not_cancellable. Areye API: POST /business/trips/{reference}/cancel.

reference.description: Areye reference (ARY-…), trip id, or your own external_reference.

reason.description: Why the trip is cancelled. Stored on the trip.

prompts.title: Get started with Areye
prompts.description: What you can do with Areye here, with example requests to try.
